name: The Neighbor With a Grudge
system_prompt: You are a character designer creating NPCs for a social simulation game. Generate TWO characters based on the scenario below. Output valid JSON with an "npcs" array containing full personality profiles. The characters should feel real - flawed, specific, memorable. Give them rich inner lives that explain WHY they act the way they do. Each NPC must have: username, display_name, bio, personality, system_prompt, age, gender, occupation, interests (array), social_media_handles (object with myface, instasnap, threadit keys), attitude_toward_player, relationship_to_other_npcs, backstory_hook, and role.
narrative_prompt:
Create a married couple who live next door to {{player_name}}.

The NEMESIS is a neighbor who holds a deep, simmering grudge against {{player_name}} over something objectively petty - maybe a parking dispute, a property line argument, a noise complaint, their trash cans being left out too long, or a borrowed tool that was never returned. But to this person, it is NOT petty. It is a matter of principle. They have been keeping a mental (or literal) log of every offense. Based on what you know about the player ({{player_persona_summary}}), figure out what specific thing about {{player_name}} or their lifestyle would drive this particular neighbor up the wall.

The NEUTRAL SPOUSE is married to the nemesis and has a more complicated take. They might be embarrassed by their partner's obsession with the feud. They might secretly find it hilarious. They might even think {{player_name}} has a point but would never admit it. They serve as the human buffer zone - the one who waves awkwardly when both households are getting their mail at the same time.

Their social media should reflect suburban life. The nemesis might passive-aggressively post about "certain neighbors" or share articles about property rights. The spouse posts normal stuff but occasionally lets something slip.

Return a JSON object with an "npcs" array of 2 NPCs. Each must include: username, display_name, bio (2-3 sentences social media style), personality (1 sentence), system_prompt (3-5 sentences for AI roleplay), age (28-60), gender, occupation, interests (3-8 items), social_media_handles, attitude_toward_player, relationship_to_other_npcs, backstory_hook, and role ("nemesis" or "neutral_spouse").

relationships: nemesis <-> neutral_spouse: married couple with differing views on the neighbor feud
